# Skin menu

TxSuite has a light and a dark skin.

## Skin → Light, Dark and Follow the system

Light and Dark pick the skin, Follow the system takes the one your system uses.
The choice is the same for every ECU and is remembered.

## Skin → Cascade windows and Tile windows

Cascade windows puts the windows in the workspace on top of each other, slightly shifted, so every title bar shows.
Tile windows horizontally and Tile windows vertically put them next to each other so they all fit.

## Skin → Dock all floating windows

Brings every window that floats outside the main window back into the workspace.
